grh_b80963143a5b43b2567d.title: A Weekend Pass
paragraphs: At Fort Gordon in 1964, Army cook Conroy Rafael, known as Steel, receives a pile of back pay and turns a two-day pass into an increasingly chaotic weekend with several buddies. Drinking, clubs, unexpected hospitality and one detour after another keep the soldiers away from post until Monday, when the narrator realizes the group has gone absent without leave. His friends scramble to cover for him, while Steel escapes serious trouble largely because an officer's wife still needs one of his recipes. The comedy takes a bittersweet turn when Steel reveals that he is about to ship out for Vietnam; the narrator later recalls that he survived the war and eventually opened a successful restaurant in the Virgin Islands.
